long_biography.plain_text:
Natural pearls shaped Hussain Ibrahim Alfardan's early business life. Born in 1933 to a prominent pearl merchant, he learned the trade from his father and revived the family enterprise after cultured pearls and wartime disruption had weakened it. In 1954 he established Alfardan Jewellery in Doha, combining inherited expertise and relationships with a new regional retail platform.

That jewellery house became the foundation of Alfardan Group. Alfardan broadened the family business into automotive distribution, property, hotels, exchange, investment, marine services and healthcare, while remaining its chairman. He also helped establish Commercial Bank and served in its leadership for five decades, giving his career a second defining strand in Qatar's banking sector.
